title: Feed Storm
style: A notification feed as weather: message bubbles and pings rain in and stack into a scrolling column, faster and faster, with motion blur on the scroll; then one calm hand (a cursor) sorts them: most fold away, three are grouped into one decision card. Clean UI, one alarm colour, one calm colour. Captions are serif word ladders (kit captions.ts): short stacks of mixed sizes, one key word in the accent italic, set beside the action and arriving word by word.
learnsFrom: Founder explainer reels (Instagram, @gregisenberg's team): complaint bubbles stacking and scrolling, a feed that overwhelms, then gets sorted into a single decision.

story.what: hook: a single ping drops in: 'can we move it?'; caption '47 messages'
pings rain in and stack ('what time works?', 'I'm out Tue', 'sorry, conflict'), the column scrolling faster with motion blur; a counter climbs to 47
everything freezes; a cursor sweeps: 44 bubbles fold away into a thin stack labelled 'handled'
the remaining 3 slide together into one card: 'Decide: Thu 15:00 or Fri 10:00?' with two buttons
the cursor taps 'Thu 15:00'; the card turns calm; caption 'one decision'
sign-off: 'Oriel' with the counter now at 1

sizes: Landscape runs the feed on the left third and the decision card and captions on the right.
sound: beatScore drive at 120 bpm with pops for each ping (thinned as they speed up), a whoosh on the sweep, a hit on the decision and the sign-off.
teaches: Overwhelm is speed plus density; relief is the same objects slowing down and collapsing into one.

portable.fonts: Inter for the UI, Instrument Serif and Instrument Serif Italic for captions
